title: Bound the Linux G03 snapshot scan
goal: Remove the Linux snapshot timeout without changing G03 semantics or its 60-second ceiling.
acceptanceCriteria: The adapter enumerates only .cs and .csproj semantic inputs and rejects linked directories and files.
The two deterministic projections and all existing snapshot counts and findings remain unchanged.
The existing 60-second capability ceiling remains unchanged.
The owning suite, combined G03 suite, matrix contract, focused Linux run, and final certification pass.
